meta.001: MarketVision Technology builds software for African businesses, with consulting and development in commerce, logistics and connected devices. Based in Jigjiga, Ethiopia.
copy.007: We build software that helps African businesses find customers and get goods moving.
copy.017: African businesses reaching customers beyond the people and places they already know.
copy.018: Build tools that help buyers, suppliers and transporters find one another and do business.
access.004: Illustration of an AfricMade supplier showroom
copy.021: Farm produce, handmade goods and manufactured products in a supplier showroom, with a location map and an enquiry form.
copy.028: Find products from African farms, factories and makers. Browse their showrooms and ask the supplier about an order, from a few items to a bulk purchase.
access.006: Illustration of the Loadgistic transport map
copy.035: A map of vehicles and routes beside a truck showing available cargo space, a private sharing option and shipment progress.
copy.039: Find space for your next load.
copy.040: Transporters share available vehicle space and routes, publicly or with selected customers. Shippers and brokers can find capacity and receive private updates on agreed shipments.
copy.046: We also work with businesses that need advice on technology or software built for their own teams.
copy.047: We help you work out what your team needs and whether your current tools can do it.
copy.048: We build websites where customers can browse your products, learn about your business and send enquiries.
copy.049: We develop software for managing vehicle availability, coordinating drivers and keeping customers informed about deliveries.
copy.050: We turn location and sensor readings into dashboards for following vehicles and equipment.
copy.052: The people doing the work know where it gets difficult. We listen before deciding what to build.
copy.054: Talk through the work with your team and find out what slows it down.
copy.055: Decide what the software needs to do and what to build first.
copy.056: Try it with the people who will use it, then improve what needs work.
copy.057: Ask about a platform, discuss a partnership or tell us what you need built.
copy.058: Please enable JavaScript to submit this form.

purpose.context: A business can have the right product and still be hard to find. A transporter can have space on a route without the right customers knowing.
portfolio.cargochatterBody: Customers can chat with logistics providers and request a quote for a parcel or a full load. You choose whose profiles appear on your website or app.
portfolio.cargochatterConnection: AfricMade hosts CargoChatter so buyers can ask about delivery while browsing products.
portfolio.cargochatterAlt: Illustration of a logistics provider profile beside a chat window on a business website
